meta.defaultScope: US domestic, main-cabin economy, one-way per passenger
meta.note: Single source of truth. api/scripts/generate-seed.mjs generates api/seed.sql from this file; the frontend imports it for prerendered content pages and as an explicitly-dated offline fallback. Every record carries provenance. Records with status 'unverified' have NOT been checked against the airline source by a data steward and are surfaced in the UI as 'Review pending'.

statusValues.verified: A named data steward compared this record against source_url on verified_at.
statusValues.unverified: Value carried over from an earlier build. Source URL is recorded so it can be checked, but no steward has confirmed it.
statusValues.assumption: Not published as a single figure by the airline. PackRight applies this as a clearly-labelled planning assumption, never as a quoted price.

assumptions.label: Oversized personal item
assumptions.change_note: Placeholder retained from the initial MVP build. Airlines do not publish a single flat oversize charge for personal items; the real outcome is usually gate-checking at that airline's carry-on or checked-bag rate. Displayed as a planning assumption only.

assumptions.label: Carry-on too large at the gate
assumptions.change_note: Placeholder retained from the initial MVP build. Gate-check outcomes vary by airline, fare and airport. Displayed as a planning assumption only.

assumptions.label: Checked bag over the weight limit
assumptions.change_note: Placeholder retained from the initial MVP build. Real overweight charges are banded (for example 51-70 lb and 71-100 lb) and differ per airline. Displayed as a planning assumption only.

assumptions.label: Third and each additional checked bag
assumptions.change_note: Placeholder retained from the initial MVP build. Displayed as a planning assumption only.

airlines.name: Frontier Airlines
airlines.change_note: Personal-item dimensions were stored as 14x18x8 in the initial MVP seed while every other airline used longest-to-shortest ordering. Normalised to 18x14x8 (same box, consistent ordering) so the fit check is not order-dependent. Not yet checked against the airline source. Frontier prices bags dynamically by route and purchase timing.

airlines.name: Southwest Airlines
airlines.change_note: Dimensions carried over unchanged from the initial MVP seed (16 x 13.5 x 8.5), which was already in longest-to-shortest order. An earlier revision of this file recorded 16.25 x 13.5 x 8 while claiming the record had only been reordered; that was wrong on both counts and the original values have been restored. Not yet checked against the airline source. Southwest's checked-bag allowance changed during 2025 and this record is a priority for steward review.
